_help: Paste your API key into "key". The default is OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible, one key for every model, cheap): get a key at https://openrouter.ai/keys and pick a model at https://openrouter.ai/models . For vanilla OpenAI set provider "openai" and url ""; for Anthropic set provider "anthropic". Any field can also be set via env: RYOKU_I18N_PROVIDER / _KEY / _MODEL / _URL (env wins, used by CI).
